It reflects the best of emotions experienced by parents upon the arrival of a newborn child. The tradition of naming infants after positive attributes in the Islamic faith is well established, and Ghassana exemplifies this perfectly. It is a name that radiates with love, joy, and excitement.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ghassana also carries a deeper spiritual significance in the Islamic faith. It reminds us of the joyful news delivered by the angels Gabriel (Jibreel) and Michael (Mikail) to the Prophet Muhammad when he was given the message of the divine revelation. The name is a constant reminder to be grateful for the blessings bestowed upon us, particularly the gift of life and the arrival of a newborn. It is also a reminder to spread good news and positivity to others, bringing joy and happiness to those around us.
